title: Points Covered by an Action Plan and Flagged Stock Removed from Fulfilled by Northloop
content:
**Coverage rule.** Which points the Seller Performance Standing action plan covers depends on the flagged stock the seller has taken out of the Fulfilled by Northloop network: for a seller whose enrollment billed a disposal removal fee in the last three whole calendar months the plan covers all the active points for action-plan relief; for a seller whose enrollment billed no disposal removal fee but a return-to-seller removal fee in that period it covers the active listing-type points, meaning the points recorded for listing policy and restricted product violations less every point expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying those types; for every other seller it covers the active listing policy points only.

## The records read

The tier is read from the removal fees billed on the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment: each removal fee entry shows its removal type — disposal or return to seller — and the date it was billed. A fee lies in the last three whole calendar months when fewer than three whole months have passed from its billing date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## The three groups of points

| Group | Meaning on the seller's standing record |
|---|---|
| All the active points for action-plan relief | the points of every violation recorded, less every point reversed and every point already expired or relieved on the record |
| Active listing-type points | the points recorded for listing policy and restricted product violations, less every point expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying either of those types |
| Active listing policy points | the points recorded for listing policy violations, less every point expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying that type |

## Decision table

| Disposal removal fee billed in the last three whole calendar months | Return-to-seller removal fee billed in that period | Points the plan covers |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | all the active points for action-plan relief |
| no | yes | active listing-type points |
| no | no | active listing policy points only |

## Hypothetical record

A standing record carries active points of 2 from a listing policy violation, 4 from a restricted product violation and 8 from an intellectual property violation, 14 in all. With a disposal fee billed two months ago the plan covers 14 points; with only a return-to-seller fee billed in the period it covers 6; with neither (or with a disposal fee billed four whole months ago and nothing since) it covers 2.
